description: Control mapping for Alibaba Cloud checks executed by Prowler. Mapping is intended for audit evidence grouping (not scoring).

control_catalog.AU-6: Audit Record Review, Analysis, and Reporting

prefix_mappings.rationale: ActionTrail checks validate account-wide API event generation and monitoring evidence.
SLS alerting checks validate audit log analysis and security event monitoring.
Password policy checks enforce authenticator strength and lifecycle requirements.
RAM checks generally support account governance and least-privilege policy enforcement.
OSS bucket security checks enforce boundary, access, and secure data transfer controls.
Security group ingress restrictions directly support network boundary and remote access controls.
ECS hardening checks support secure configuration and vulnerability reduction.
RDS checks primarily validate hardened database configuration and cryptographic safeguards.
Security Center checks validate endpoint monitoring and vulnerability detection coverage.
Kubernetes checks validate secure baseline settings and cluster network hardening.
VPC flow logging checks support network activity visibility and boundary monitoring.

actiontrail_oss_bucket_not_publicly_acce.rationale: Protecting ActionTrail storage from public access helps preserve integrity and confidentiality of audit data.

ram_no_root_access_key.rationale: Removing root keys enforces least privilege and prevents unmanaged highly privileged authenticators.

ram_policy_no_administrative_privileges.rationale: Checks for wildcard administrative permissions directly validate least-privilege authorization.

ram_policy_attached_only_to_group_or_rol.rationale: Restricting direct user policy attachment supports controlled account provisioning and privilege governance.

ram_rotate_access_key_90_days.rationale: Access key rotation enforces authenticator lifecycle management and periodic credential renewal.

ram_user_console_access_unused.rationale: Disabling dormant console users supports account lifecycle management and reduced attack surface.

ram_user_mfa_enabled_console_access.rationale: MFA on privileged console access directly supports multi-factor user authentication requirements.

oss_bucket_logging_enabled.rationale: Object storage logging enables generation of auditable events for data access operations.

oss_bucket_not_publicly_accessible.rationale: Public access controls enforce authorization boundaries for cloud object storage.

oss_bucket_secure_transport_enabled.rationale: TLS-only bucket access enforces confidentiality and integrity for data in transit.

ecs_attached_disk_encrypted.rationale: Attached disk encryption demonstrates cryptographic protection of data at rest.

ecs_unattached_disk_encrypted.rationale: Snapshot and detached disk encryption protects residual data at rest.

ecs_instance_endpoint_protection_install.rationale: Endpoint protection agent deployment supports host monitoring and threat detection.

ecs_instance_latest_os_patches_applied.rationale: Operating system patch currency directly maps to flaw remediation requirements.

ecs_instance_no_legacy_network.rationale: Migrating from legacy networking to VPC improves enforceable boundary controls and baseline consistency.

rds_instance_no_public_access_whitelist.rationale: Disallowing public database whitelist entries enforces restricted network boundary exposure.

rds_instance_postgresql_log_connections_.rationale: Connection logging provides evidence for database access event generation.

rds_instance_postgresql_log_disconnectio.rationale: Disconnection logging provides complete session activity records for audit trail completeness.

rds_instance_postgresql_log_duration_ena.rationale: Statement duration logging supports forensic analysis and anomalous behavior review.

rds_instance_sql_audit_enabled.rationale: SQL audit checks verify generation and analysis capability of database activity logs.

rds_instance_sql_audit_retention.rationale: Audit retention checks provide direct evidence that audit records are preserved for required periods.

rds_instance_ssl_enabled.rationale: Database SSL enforcement protects sensitive data integrity and confidentiality in transit.

rds_instance_tde_enabled.rationale: Transparent data encryption enforces cryptographic protection for stored database data.

rds_instance_tde_key_custom.rationale: Customer-managed key usage supports key establishment and lifecycle governance.

securitycenter_advanced_or_enterprise_ed.rationale: Advanced monitoring edition indicates availability of stronger detection and monitoring capability.

securitycenter_all_assets_agent_installe.rationale: Full agent coverage supports continuous host monitoring and telemetry completeness.

securitycenter_notification_enabled_high.rationale: High-risk notifications support incident handling workflows and detection-to-response handoff.

securitycenter_vulnerability_scan_enable.rationale: Scheduled vulnerability scans directly support vulnerability monitoring and remediation prioritization.

sls_logstore_retention_period.rationale: Log retention period checks ensure audit records are retained for required forensic windows.

sls_management_console_authentication_fa.rationale: Failed authentication alerting supports timely detection of brute-force and credential abuse attempts.

sls_management_console_signin_without_mf.rationale: Alerts for console sign-ins without MFA validate monitoring controls around authentication policy violations.

cs_kubernetes_cloudmonitor_enabled.rationale: CloudMonitor telemetry on cluster resources supports continuous monitoring and anomaly visibility.

cs_kubernetes_cluster_check_recent.rationale: Recency of security baseline checks indicates continuous assessment of cluster configuration state.

cs_kubernetes_dashboard_disabled.rationale: Disabling insecure management dashboard reduces broad interactive access pathways.

cs_kubernetes_eni_multiple_ip_enabled.rationale: Proper ENI IP management supports predictable network segmentation and policy enforcement in clusters.

cs_kubernetes_log_service_enabled.rationale: Cluster log service integration validates generation and central analysis of security-relevant events.

cs_kubernetes_network_policy_enabled.rationale: Network policy enforcement directly constrains pod-to-pod and namespace traffic flow.

cs_kubernetes_private_cluster_enabled.rationale: Private control-plane access limits externally reachable management interfaces.

cs_kubernetes_rbac_enabled.rationale: RBAC configuration validates role-based authorization and least-privilege assignment.

vpc_flow_logs_enabled.rationale: Flow logs provide network boundary telemetry needed for audit and detection workflows.
